title: Scope modifiers for personal access tokens and OAuth are generally available
body: Scope modifiers narrow an API scope to a subset of its operations, such as `clusters:read` for read operations or `sql:restricted-query` for read-only SQL queries, in personal access tokens, OAuth secrets, and OAuth token requests. See [Narrow API scopes with scope modifiers](/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/scope-modifiers).

ref_links.text: Narrow API scopes with scope modifiers
